why: idle with this session's flag: main's committed self-compact.sh runs, as stop <pid>
idle with no flag: nothing runs
a prompt (working) with a flag: nothing runs
a Stop that a stop hook continued (stop_hook_active): nothing runs; the request lapses (the next Stop skips as prompted)
a payload the hook can't parse: nothing runs
a payload without stop_hook_active: nothing runs (only a literal false lets it through)
a script that hangs never delays Stop (detached)
a script that fails never fails Stop
main's lib.sh (sourced by the script) differs from HEAD: nothing runs
self-compact.sh on main's disk but never committed: nothing runs
lib.sh on main's disk but never committed: nothing runs
self-compact.sh committed but deleted from main's tree: nothing runs
missing from main's tree with an empty diff (skip-worktree): nothing runs, an empty diff proves nothing
the script edited under skip-worktree (git diff reads clean): nothing runs, checked by content
lib.sh edited under skip-worktree: nothing runs
lib.sh edited behind main's own clean filter (git diff reads clean): nothing runs, raw bytes compared
lib.sh edited and main's HEAD replaced by a commit holding the edit (refs/replace/): nothing runs
a board file the script never runs differs: it still runs
run from a lane worktree whose own copy differs: main's committed copy runs, never the branch's
an inherited GIT_DIR pointing at another repo: main is still found from the hook's own path
an inherited GIT_COMMON_DIR pointing at another repo: main is still found from the hook's own path
